report: Component-isolated ablations (MCTS weights, base-utility weights, equal weights; early exit on/off) plus cached sparse FFN on 28-layer Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct; 100 balanced BoolQ rows, seeded stratified 5-fold GPU cross-fit; CPU fold 0 (20 rows)

module_sha256_verification.note: sha256sum of the three repo files equals module_sha256 recorded inside both runs byte for byte; the GPU node holds byte-identical copies under pkg/gen_zero/causal (checked with certutil before launch)

mcts_multihook_dense_ffn.description: reference arm: MCTS-refined hook weights plus the calibrated early-exit rule

multihook_weighted_full28_no_early_exit.description: same fitted MCTS hook weights, min_exit_layer set past the last layer so all 28 layers run; vs the reference it isolates dynamic early exit

multihook_no_mcts_margin_early_exit.description: softmax of the per-layer anchor utilities (no MCTS search), identical early-exit rule and min_exit_layer; vs the reference it isolates MCTS weight refinement

gpu_launcher_source:
"""GPU-node launcher: run benchmarks/suites/benchmark_layerwise_mcts_qwen15b.py on the A100.

pkg/gen_zero/causal holds byte-identical copies of the repo modules (sha256 in the report);
the two package __init__.py files are empty so only these modules load.
"""
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path[:0] = [os.path.join(HERE, "pkg"), HERE]
import benchmark_layerwise_mcts_qwen15b as suite  # noqa: E402

MODEL = r"D:\hf_cache\hub\models--Qwen--Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct\snapshots\989aa7980e4cf806f80c7fef2b1adb7bc71aa306"
sys.exit(suite.main([
    "--hf-model", MODEL, "--data", os.path.join(HERE, "boolq.jsonl"),
    "--device", "cuda", "--dtype", "float32", "--n", "100", "--folds", "5",
    "--label", "NVIDIA A100 full 100-row 5-fold (b1019r2-w3 component ablations)",
    "--out", os.path.join(HERE, "layerwise_mcts_qwen15b_report_gpu.json"),
]))
cpu_command: env PYTHONPATH=python ~/.venv-gz-torch/bin/python benchmarks/suites/benchmark_layerwise_mcts_qwen15b.py --device cpu --threads 8 --eval-folds "[0]" --ffn-grid "" --label "dev CPU fold-0 rerun (b1019r2-w3 component ablations)" --out /tmp/b1019r2-w3_cpu.json  (REMOTE_DONE rc=0 real=1299.782s)
caveats: No accuracy difference between arms is statistically significant: every exact McNemar p-value against mcts_multihook_dense_ffn is >= 0.45 at n=100 (GPU) and the CPU fold has n=20.

GPU: MCTS-weighted multihook with early exit 80/100 equals the same weights at full depth (80/100, 100/100 agreement), so dynamic early exit costs no accuracy here while running 25.11 of 28 layers on average.
GPU: base-utility weights without MCTS refinement reach 78/100 at 23.34 mean layers; equal weights at full depth reach 78/100. The 2-row gaps to the MCTS arm are within noise.

Ablation arms are real timed runner.ablation_predict calls. The Rust suite's two full-depth ablation arms reuse the dense capture pass and copy full_28_uncalibrated timing; do not compare ablation timing across suites.
CPU timing is one run on a shared host; loadavg went from 56.2 to 12.6 and the Rust BoolQ benchmark ran on the same host at the same time. Treat CPU ms/row as indicative only.
GPU and CPU e2e per-row timing includes chat template, tokenizer, transfer, and predict; model load and fitting are excluded and reported separately.

The dense MCTS arm moved from 81/100 (2026-10-18 report) to 80/100. The runner changed in between (Round 2 M07/M08 memory fixes), but this 1-row change is not attributed to any specific fix and is within noise.
